"""One explicit migration for the split documents delivered on 2026-11-03.

No product addresses or parsing branches: all structures come from the file.
The output is the single canonical ble-thing-mapping/1 contract.
"""
import copy
import hashlib
import ble_protocol_mapping as codec


def check(ok, message):
    codec.require(ok, "DEFINITION_MIGRATION", message)


def migrate(model, source, model_text):
    from ble_thing_mapping import json_text, normalize_model, model_hash
    required = {"format", "id", "version", "thing_model_ref", "thing_model_id", "thing_model_version", "description", "source_revisions", "common", "commands", "thing_model_sha256"}
    check(set(source) == required, "拆分映射的顶层字段与已知迁移定义不一致")
    check(model.get("format") == "thing-model-definition/1.0", "拆分物模型格式不匹配")
    normalize_model(model)
    check(source["thing_model_id"] == model.get("id") and source["thing_model_version"] == model.get("version"), "拆分映射引用的物模型ID或版本不匹配")
    raw = (model_text if model_text is not None else json_text(model)).lstrip("\ufeff").encode("utf-8")
    codec.require(source["thing_model_sha256"] == hashlib.sha256(raw).hexdigest(), "MODEL_REFERENCE", "拆分映射引用的物模型内容SHA256不匹配")
    common = source["common"]
    check(model_hash(common) == "c069e9eee21fa007c436f2d08c488ba73d29370740b5325baa0b50e57a24eb6e", "旧拆分公共定义与已登记迁移版本不同；请按统一Schema重新生成，不忽略变更内容")
    check(set(common) == {"pdu", "tlv", "wire_types", "numeric_conversion", "field_groups", "interaction_types", "public_result", "empty_reply", "correlation", "property_updates", "availability"}, "拆分公共定义存在未支持内容")
    expected_keys = {
        "pdu": {"layout", "max_bytes", "scope"},
        "tlv": {"type_bytes", "logical_type_bits", "container_flag", "length", "addresses", "required"},
        "numeric_conversion": {"formula", "scale_default", "offset_default", "integer_constraint"},
        "field_groups": {"at_least_one", "all_or_none"},
        "interaction_types": {"request_response", "query_and_report", "receive_only"},
        "public_result": {"id", "wire_type", "length", "value_encoding", "success_code", "success_pdu_example", "error_code_policy", "model_binding"},
        "empty_reply": {"meaning", "result_known"},
        "correlation": {"unmarked", "none", "timeout_ms", "timeout_note"},
        "property_updates": {"merge", "identity_note"},
        "availability": {"active", "suspended"},
    }
    for key, keys in expected_keys.items():
        check(isinstance(common[key], dict) and set(common[key]) == keys, "拆分公共定义字段不匹配：" + key)
    check(set(common["tlv"]["length"]) == {"encoding", "bytes", "value", "range", "canonical"}, "未知Length迁移字段")
    check(common["empty_reply"]["result_known"] is False, "不能将空回包迁移为成功")
    check(common["pdu"]["layout"] == ["SID:uint8", "CID:uint8", "TLV[]"] and common["pdu"]["max_bytes"] == codec.MAX_PDU, "不支持该PDU布局或容量")
    check(common["tlv"]["type_bytes"] == 1 and common["tlv"]["length"]["bytes"] == [1, 2] and common["tlv"]["length"]["range"] == [0, 16383], "TLV布局与当前编码器不一致")
    check(common["numeric_conversion"]["formula"] == "model_value = wire_value * scale + offset" and common["numeric_conversion"]["scale_default"] == "1" and common["numeric_conversion"]["offset_default"] == "0", "数值换算规则不支持")
    check(set(common["wire_types"]) <= set(codec.NUM) | {"utf8", "bytes", "object", "array", "repeated_object", "bool", "group"}, "未支持的编码类型")
    for wire, description in common["wire_types"].items():
        allowed = {"bytes", "encoding"} | ({"byte_order"} if wire in codec.NUM and codec.NUM[wire][1] > 1 else set()) | ({"length_unit"} if wire == "utf8" else set())
        check(set(description) <= allowed, "编码类型包含未知迁移字段：" + wire)
        if wire in codec.NUM:
            check(description.get("bytes") == codec.NUM[wire][1] and (codec.NUM[wire][1] == 1 or description.get("byte_order") == "big-endian"), "数值宽度或字节序不支持")
    public_result = common["public_result"]
    check(public_result["id"] == "R3.common_u32_7f" and public_result["wire_type"] == "0x7F" and public_result["length"] == 4 and public_result["value_encoding"] == "uint32 big-endian", "公共结果格式不支持")
    check(common["correlation"].get("timeout_ms") is None, "不支持公共默认业务超时，必须逐指令声明")

    def resolve(reference):
        check(isinstance(reference, str) and reference.startswith(source["thing_model_ref"] + "#/"), "模型引用必须指向本次物模型")
        node = model
        for token in reference.split("#", 1)[1][1:].split("/"):
            token = token.replace("~1", "/").replace("~0", "~")
            check(isinstance(node, dict) and token in node, "模型引用不存在：" + reference)
            node = node[token]
        return node

    mapping = {"format": "ble-thing-mapping/1", "id": source["id"], "version": source["version"], "description": source["description"], "sourceRevisions": copy.deepcopy(source["source_revisions"]), "modelRef": {"id": source["thing_model_id"], "version": source["thing_model_version"], "sha256": source["thing_model_sha256"]}, "commands": [], "provenance": {"migratedFrom": source["format"], "sourceDefinitionMetadata": {"common": copy.deepcopy(common), "thing_model_ref": source["thing_model_ref"]}}}
    for old in source["commands"]:
        check(set(old) <= {"operation", "address", "availability", "model_binding", "interaction", "layouts", "notes"}, "指令包含未支持的迁移字段")
        address, target, interaction = old["address"], old["model_binding"], old["interaction"]
        check(set(address) == {"sid", "cid", "header_hex"} and address["header_hex"] == f"{int(address['sid'],16):02X} {int(address['cid'],16):02X}", "SID/CID与帧头不一致")
        check(set(target) == {"kind", "ref"} and target["kind"] in {"service", "event"}, "此迁移只接受明确的服务或事件引用")
        resolve(target["ref"])
        identifier = target["ref"].split("/")[-1]
        expected_target = source["thing_model_ref"] + "#/" + ("services/" if target["kind"] == "service" else "events/") + identifier
        check(target["ref"] == expected_target, "业务引用种类和路径不一致")
        check(set(interaction) == {"type", "downlink_request_defined", "receive_variants", "correlation", "timeout_ms", "result_component"}, "交互定义存在未支持字段")
        check(interaction["downlink_request_defined"] == ("request" in old["layouts"]), "请求存在性声明与布局不一致")
        check(interaction["result_component"] == ("R3.common_u32_7f" if "result" in interaction["receive_variants"] else None), "公共结果组件声明不一致")
        command = {"id": old["operation"], "sid": address["sid"], "cid": address["cid"], "availability": old["availability"], "target": {"kind": target["kind"], "identifier": identifier}, "interaction": interaction["type"], "receiveVariants": interaction["receive_variants"], "correlation": interaction["correlation"], "timeoutMs": interaction["timeout_ms"]}
        if "result" in command["receiveVariants"]:
            command["resultSuccessCode"] = public_result["success_code"]
        if "notes" in old:
            command["notes"] = copy.deepcopy(old["notes"])
        groups = []
        for role, layout in old["layouts"].items():
            check(role in {"request", "incoming"} and set(layout) <= {"direction", "schema_ref", "model_path_base", "fields", "property_targets"}, "布局存在未支持字段")
            check(layout["direction"] == ("app_to_device" if role == "request" else "device_to_app"), "方向与布局角色不一致")
            expected_schema = expected_target + (("/input" if role == "request" else "/output") if target["kind"] == "service" else "")
            check(layout["schema_ref"] == expected_schema, "字段引用的模型作用域与指令不一致")
            check(layout["model_path_base"] == "各字段model_path均相对于schema_ref对应的数据对象", "不支持此字段路径作用域声明")
            schema = resolve(layout["schema_ref"])
            command[role] = []

            def flatten(nodes, parent=(), parent_wire=(), parent_node=None):
                for node in nodes:
                    check(set(node) <= {"type_id", "model_path", "key", "wire_type", "required", "scale", "offset", "max_bytes", "children", "groups", "logical_path", "wire_path", "wire_type_byte", "value_bytes", "hex_characters"}, "字段包含未支持的迁移信息")
                    logical = parent + (node["type_id"],)
                    byte = node["type_id"] | (128 if node["wire_type"] in {"object", "array", "repeated_object"} else 0)
                    wire = parent_wire + (byte,)
                    check(node["logical_path"] == "/".join(f"{x:02X}" for x in logical) and node["wire_path"] == "/".join(f"{x:02X}" for x in wire) and int(node["wire_type_byte"], 16) == byte, "逻辑Type与实际Type路径不一致")
                    field_schema = codec.schema_at(schema, node["model_path"])
                    prefix = parent_node["model_path"] + ("[]" if parent_node["wire_type"] == "repeated_object" else "") if parent_node else ""
                    expected_key = None if (parent_node and parent_node["wire_type"] == "array") or node["wire_type"] == "group" else node["model_path"][len(prefix) + 1:] if prefix else node["model_path"]
                    check(node["key"] == expected_key, "字段key与模型路径不一致")
                    if "value_bytes" in node or "hex_characters" in node:
                        count = node.get("value_bytes")
                        check(type(count) is int and node["wire_type"] == "bytes" and node.get("hex_characters") == count * 2 and node["max_bytes"] == count and field_schema.get("minLength") == count * 2 and field_schema.get("maxLength") == count * 2, "固定字节长度信息不一致")
                    f = {"field": node["model_path"], "tlv": node["logical_path"], "wireType": node["wire_type"], "required": node["required"], "scale": node["scale"], "offset": node["offset"]}
                    if node["max_bytes"] is not None:
                        f["maxBytes"] = node["max_bytes"]
                    command[role].append(f)
                    for group in node["groups"]:
                        groups.append({"role": role, "container": node["logical_path"], **copy.deepcopy(group)})
                    flatten(node["children"], logical, wire, node)
            flatten(layout["fields"])
            if "property_targets" in layout:
                check(role == "incoming", "属性更新只允许上行布局")
                updates = []
                for update in layout["property_targets"]:
                    check(set(update) == {"source_path", "schema_ref"}, "属性更新存在未知字段")
                    resolve(update["schema_ref"])
                    prop = update["schema_ref"].split("/")[-1]
                    check(update["schema_ref"] == source["thing_model_ref"] + "#/properties/" + prop, "属性更新目标须为顶层物模型属性")
                    updates.append({"from": update["source_path"], "to": prop})
                command["propertyUpdates"] = updates
        if groups:
            command["constraints"] = groups
        mapping["commands"].append(command)
    mapping["modelRef"]["sha256"] = model_hash(model)
    from ble_thing_mapping import required_capabilities
    mapping["requiredCapabilities"] = sorted(required_capabilities(model, mapping))
    return model, mapping
